# AWS Chaos Engineering Framework 2.0.3

Version 2.0.3 is a corrective distribution-only update. It does not broaden live AWS behavior or weaken any safety gate from 2.0.2.

## Why this patch exists

Qualification of the unpublished 2.0.2 draft found that its source distribution included the release builder and release tests but omitted the versioned release notes required by those tests. Runtime installation, exact source identity, and the complete 79-entry catalog passed, but the package was not self-testing.

The public `v2.0.2` tag remains fixed. Its draft release was not published, and this patch uses a new version rather than moving or reusing that tag.

## Correction

- Includes versioned release notes and the tag workflow in the source distribution.
- Uses a generic release-notes manifest rule so later patch versions inherit the same package contract.
- Requires repeat builds to contain both release inputs before release assets are accepted.
- Canonicalizes regular source-archive member modes across mounted Windows filesystems and native Git checkouts.
- Runs all 101 tests plus 4 parameterized subtests from both the source tree and an extracted source distribution.

## Distribution integrity

- Provides an exact standalone Python file, normalized pure-Python wheel, normalized source distribution, SPDX 2.3 dependency SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and machine-readable release evidence.
- Requires two independent builds to produce the same six files byte for byte.
- Pins direct runtime, development, and build inputs for auditable candidate construction.
- Creates only a draft GitHub release from a tag that points to a verified protected-main commit.
- Does not publish to PyPI or any other package registry.

## Safety boundary

Plan mode remains the default. Live execution still requires explicit CLI intent, exact account and region binding, target controls, alarms, and confirmation tokens. Irreversible behavior still requires independent configuration and CLI approval.

The release gate never uses AWS credentials and never contacts an AWS account. Use this software only in isolated, non-production environments that you own or are explicitly authorized to test.

## Assets

- `AWS-Chaos-Engineering-Framework-v2.0.3.py`: exact standalone runtime
- `aws_chaos_engineering_framework-2.0.3-py3-none-any.whl`: Python wheel
- `aws_chaos_engineering_framework-2.0.3.tar.gz`: normalized source distribution
- `AWS-Chaos-Engineering-Framework-v2.0.3.spdx.json`: SPDX 2.3 direct-dependency SBOM
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 digests for the runtime, packages, and SBOM
- `release-evidence.json`: source commit, artifact identities, dependencies, and archive membership

Verify checksums and provenance before installation. Review the plan and every target, alarm, permission, blast-radius, and recovery setting before any authorized live run.
